description: List upcoming US earnings reports for a date range (up to 14 days, US Eastern dates), largest and most-watched companies first. Optional group: bigtech, semiconductors, software, memory, healthcare, space. Use for "이번 주 실적 발표 일정", "다음 주 빅테크 실적 언제야?", "Which chip stocks report next week?". Defaults to the next 7 days. The result is shown as a calendar card.

group.description: Only this group of companies, e.g. "bigtech" or "semiconductors". Omit for all companies

lang.description: Answer language. Use "ko" when the user writes in Korean, otherwise "en".

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern. Default: from + 6 days

name: get_earnings_calendar

status.description: estimated = projected from past cadence, not announced

time_kst.description: Korea time, only when the source gives a time

total.description: all matching reports; items may be fewer

title: Earnings calendar
